title: Number and boolean comparand doors: the refusal says a {placeholder} "resolves to an id or a date", but a period key resolves to an ISO week key
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvVRcFWKrfWeG5jzPb

Filing gate ①, Source: fleet. Out-of-scope finding of the T1 stale-prose dev (PR #35806, os-dev-report 7035287739), widened and ruled "file before landing" by the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review of that PR (record 7035670717, S4), and filed as a p3 rider for the next stale-prose batch on L1 7035433107. Dedupe: `placeholder resolves to an id or a date`, `id or a date placeholder number door` and `ISO week key placeholder number door` return only #35522, #34611 and #35409 (the three cards PR #35806 closes; none names these sentences) and #35496 (skills text for `{current_iso_week}`, a different surface).

## What happens (read at PR #35806 head `a555ecc5`, same on `origin/main`)
The number door and its boolean arm refuse any `{placeholder}` comparand on a `number` / `boolean` field. They explain the refusal by saying the token "resolves to an id or a date". Since #35391, a period key (`{current_iso_week}`) resolves to an ISO week key, which is neither of those. The conclusion still holds, because no token resolves to a number or a boolean. The stated reason is incomplete, and after #35806 one file says two different things: its header lists the ISO week key, while its message does not.

Places (from the review record):
- runtime strings: `packages/spec/src/data/filter-number-comparand-declared-type.ts:524`, `packages/spec/src/data/filter-boolean-comparand-declared-type.ts:388`;
- docblocks and comments: `filter-number-comparand-declared-type.ts:295`, `filter-boolean-comparand-declared-type.ts:59-60`, `packages/objectql/src/number-comparand-declared-type-door.ts:57-58`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts:965-966`;
- a stale "steps around a placeholder" in `packages/objectql/src/engine-resolved-token-year-range.test.ts:25-26`.

reach: published refusal text of `@objectstack/spec` (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400; the code and status are unchanged). Authors who read the refusal are told a reason that does not cover the token they wrote. Read from code.

## Done when
Every place above states what a placeholder resolves to (an id, a date, or an ISO week key), or says only that no token resolves to a number or a boolean. Move the pins on the two runtime strings with them. Add a patch changeset with FROM/TO for the two messages. Clause-② no.

## Business rationale
An author who writes `{current_iso_week}` against a number field gets a refusal whose reason names neither what they wrote nor what it becomes, and the next fix they try is a guess. Reader: the area:data lane seat (d7-C), as a rider on the next stale-prose batch.

Grade: p3 · area:data · Bug (prose) · authors using period keys on number/boolean fields, rarely · evidence read.
